instruction: An action sports photograph captured from an eye-level medium shot. Inside a brightly lit judo dojo with yellow tatami mats, the woman with curly hair in a bun (R1) wearing a blue judogi spars with the young man with short dark hair (R2) wearing a white judogi. Standing on the left, R1 grips R2's sleeve, while R2, positioned on the right, holds R1's shoulder in a dynamic, low-center-of-gravity grappling stance. Natural light filters in from large windows in the background, illuminating the sparring partners.
